title: Nguyên lý Quan hệ công chúng

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the nature, role, and functions of public relations; Organize public relations activities in organizations; Manage public relations processes; Handle typical publics; Conduct crisis management, event management, and sponsorship management; Write and present effectively.
Communicate effectively with various publics, including media, internal staff, community, and investors.
Analyze situations to support decision-making and propose public relations solutions for organizations.
Work effectively in teams to choose topics and solve public relations issues.
Take initiative in learning, research, and presenting results.
